method.bootstrap: 10,000 fixed-seed percentile resamples of the 15 paired blocks; exploratory because three trace seeds repeat
method.paired_delta: candidate minus reference on each run-level mean or median, plus long-class p90/p95/max; percentage uses reference denominator
method.percentiles: nearest rank for pooled request p90/p95
method.pooled_request_unit: descriptive only; requests are not independent policy replicates

service_order.crossover_proxy_definition: Older request admitted at least the nominal threshold before a shorter request and still unselected at the younger admission; scheduler first-enqueue times and candidate decisions are unavailable.
